parts.text: Nobody is going to clap for you at the beginning.
When you start, it's quiet. No likes. No support. Just you, and an empty room.
Your friends don't get it. Your family asks when you'll get a real job.
Some days, you'll ask yourself if it's even worth it.
Even when it feels like nobody cares.
And then one day, it hits you.
They were never supposed to clap.
This was never their dream. It was yours.
So stop waiting for applause. Post the video anyway. Write the page anyway. Show up anyway.
But by then, you won't need it.
